title: Software Developer - AI Specialisation
job_description:
Bachelor's in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related. 3-5 years in software development, with AI/ML focus (e.g., Python, Java). Experience with cloud tools (e.g., AWS SageMaker) and version control (e.g., Git). Familiarity with logistics software; proactive learner. Malaysian citizens prioritized.

Develop software components for AI applications, including APIs, data pipelines, and integration modules. Specialize in AI features like predictive modeling and automation scripting for warehouse optimization. Write clean, scalable code to support real-time inventory tracking and fulfillment. Test and debug systems to ensure reliability and performance improvements. Work closely with engineers and managers to meet project deliverables

Salary range RM8k-15k/month with bonus opportunities. Engaging work on innovative tech. Continuous training and career progression. Comprehensive benefits including EPF, SOCSO, and team-building activities

Artificial Intelligence (AI) Machine Learning Python Deep Learning Software Development
